Hi, it's Tom again, the recruiter from Miami. I have worked as a recruiter for twelve years, and I have read thousands of profiles. Here is my secret: I read three things first. First, the headline. Second, the first two lines of the summary. Third, the dates: how long has this person worked in the area, and how long have they been in the current job? I love numbers. When a person writes: I have led a team of fifteen people since 2020, I understand the experience in two seconds. And one more thing: if your profile is in English, I can send it to my clients in other countries. That is a big advantage.

Hello, I'm Rachel, and this is the summary on my profile. I have worked in human resources for twenty years. I started in payroll, and I have been an HR director since 2018. I am based in Edinburgh, but I have led teams in Scotland, Ireland and Sweden. I have a degree in psychology. My biggest achievement? We have reduced the time to hire a new person from sixty days to thirty. I love training new managers, and I have mentored more than forty people. I am always happy to connect with people in my network, so please send me a message.
